Definition: from the base of G4813 and (the reduplicated form of) G71; to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce:--spoil.
BiblicalUsage: Paul warns the Colossians not to let anyone spoil them, or carry them off as plunder, through philosophy and empty deceit, through the traditions of men and the rudiments of the world rather than Christ. The picture is a raid: false teaching does not argue you out of the faith so much as haul you away from it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the danger Paul names is still the live one, that a clever system can carry me off from Christ while I think I am only thinking, so I hold fast to Christ Himself rather than to any teaching that adds to Him.
